score_start: max(256, number of rows strictly before floor(50% of full unique dates))

selection.boundaries: exact fractions of unique dates in the FULL CSV
selection.criterion: sum 4+ indicators across k9..16 in past window only
selection.tie_break: baseline first, then formula-parent count, then candidate ID
selection.gates: no invalid source/flat-combination fallback in past window; every raw boundary tie fraction<.5; baseline reserve explicit
selection.future: choice fixed until next origin; future invalidity reported without reselection

primary: rolling selector vs Markov on80..100% of original days; constrained2
diagnostic: rolling selector70..80%; no parameter retuning after results
secondary: raw topN uses SAME choices as constrained2;3+,mean hits,zero;208 static candidates on final20%

inference.unit: whole day; same swap for all8 pools and same-day draws
inference.external: same selector from local past on six archives; last20% per country; pooled country:date
inference.static_holm_families: all208 statics in RO and all208 in pooled external, separately; controls excluded
inference.superiority_gate: positive selector difference and one-sided p<.05 in BOTH RO and pooled external
inference.assumption: paired date-level label exchangeability; day bootstrap does not prove robustness to serial dependence

limitations: All histories were explored previously. No virgin holdout, no IID full-search replay, no proof of future advantage. No automatic production promotion from reused retrospective data.
